submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed that among the ten candidate exposures, only anneal_temp had a robust direct association with tensile_mpa after accounting for lab (univariate exposure+lab: coef=0.32, p=0.02; full multivariate model with all exposures+lab: coef=0.36, p=0.008). The apparent raw correlation of porosity (r=0.28) was entirely a lab confound (porosity R^2 with lab = 0.30; within-lab effect null, p=0.69). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of tensile_mpa on anneal_temp plus site indicators on held-out data confirmed a positive direct effect: estimate=0.688, SE=0.132, p=2.8e-7 (n=396, alpha=0.05).

D = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

M = sm.add_constant(M)
fit = sm.OLS(D['tensile_mpa'].values, M.values).fit()
names = list(M.columns)
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    if n in X:
        print(n, round(fit.params[i],4), round(fit.pvalues[i],4))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
D = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
X = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
D = D.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
labd = pd.get_dummies(D['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)

# univariate: exposure + lab
print("=== Univariate (exposure + lab) ===")
for e in X:
    dd = D.dropna(subset=[e])
    M = sm.add_constant(pd.concat([dd[[e]], labd.loc[dd.index]], axis=1))
    fit = sm.OLS(dd['tensile_mpa'].values, M.values).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={fit.params[1]: .4f}  p={fit.pvalues[1]:.4f}  n={len(dd)}")

# multivariate all exposures + lab
print("\n=== Multivariate (all exposures + lab) ===")
dd = D.dropna(subset=X)
M = sm.add_constant(pd.concat([dd[X], labd.loc[dd.index]], axis=1))
fit = sm.OLS(dd['tensile_mpa'].values, M.values).fit()
for i,e in enumerate(X):
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={fit.params[i+1]: .4f}  p={fit.pvalues[i+1]:.4f}")

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
D = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
X = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']

labd = pd.get_dummies(D['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)

# univariate: exposure + lab
print("=== Univariate (exposure + lab) ===")
for e in X:
    dd = D.dropna(subset=[e])
    M = sm.add_constant(pd.concat([dd[[e]], labd.loc[dd.index]], axis=1))
    fit = sm.OLS(dd['tensile_mpa'].values, M.values).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={fit.params[1]: .4f}  p={fit.pvalues[1]:.4f}  n={len(dd)}")

# multivariate all exposures + lab
print("\n=== Multivariate (all exposures + lab) ===")
dd = D.dropna(subset=X)
M = sm.add_constant(pd.concat([dd[X], labd.loc[dd.index]], axis=1))
fit = sm.OLS(dd['tensile_mpa'].values, M.values).fit()
for i,e in enumerate(X):
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={fit.params[i+1]: .4f}  p={fit.pvalues[i+1]:.4f}")
print("n =", len(dd))
"}
